senses.gloss: a Roman emperor freq. mentioned as a friend of R. Judah Han-Nassi, and supposed to be Ant. Alexander Severus (Graetz) or Ant. Marcus Aurelius (Rap. a. oth.).
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 10a:13">Ab. Zar. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>אסוירוס בר א׳</he> Severus son of A.; <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 10b:16">Ib.ᵇ</cite> A. son of Severus.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 1:11:4">Y. Meg. I, 72ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>אית מילין וכ׳</he> there is one report that A. embraced the Jewish religion, another &c.—Y. Snh. X, 29ᶜ <he>אנטוני׳</he> a. <he>אנטולי׳</he>; cmp.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 9:3:3">Y. Kil. IX, 32ᵇ</cite> top.—
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 9:10:2">Koh. R. to IX, 10</cite> <he>אנטלימוס וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.)

senses.gloss: <he>א׳ זעירא</he> A. junior, grandson of the former. Ibid. to X, 5.—[
(?) a Roman general mentioned in conversation with R. Joh. b. Zaccai; v. <cite ref="A00319"><he>אגניטוס</he></cite>.]
